behavioral.label: skills prop (catalog data source)
behavioral.evidence: App.tsx:340 calls voxTransport.getCatalog() → invoke('get_command_catalog') on mount, stores result in data.skills, passed through surfaceComponents.tsx:110 as <Catalog skills={props.data.skills} />. CatalogEntry = CommandCatalogEntry (alias). Live backend feed confirmed.

behavioral.label: Command list item onClick → handleCommandSelect
behavioral.evidence: onClick calls handleCommandSelect(cmd.path) which sets selectedPath, seeds argValues from cmd.arguments defaults, and clears output. Pure local state — no backend call needed. Works correctly.

behavioral.label: Execute button onClick → handleExecute
behavioral.evidence: Calls voxTransport.callTool(selectedPath.replace(/ /g,'_'), {...argsObj, __argv:parsedArgs}). Transport resolves via action manifest → mcp (invoke_mcp_tool) or cli path (execute_command). Structured argValues are merged with raw __argv input. Partial: callTool has hardcoded fast-paths only for vox_list_models/vox_set_active_model/vox_explain_model/vox_suggest_model; all other commands fall through to manifest lookup. If manifest lookup misses (action not found, no cli_path, resolvePath fails) transport still tries invoke('execute_command') — may error at runtime. Output panel correctly displays exit_code, stdout, stderr.

visual.issue: Uses Tailwind color `bg-cyan/10`, `border-cyan`, `text-cyan` inline in className string. These are design-system token names (not hex), but `cyan` is a raw palette alias rather than a semantic token (e.g. `text-accent`). If the palette renames, this breaks silently.
`text-red-400` for REQUIRED label — hardcoded Tailwind color, not a semantic token. Should use `text-destructive` or equivalent.
`text-red-500` for error output — hardcoded color, not semantic token.
`text-green-500` for exit_code 0 and `text-red-500` for non-zero — hardcoded Tailwind colors, not semantic.
`text-cyan` for stdout pre block — raw palette alias, not semantic token.
`text-red-400` for stderr pre block — hardcoded color, not semantic token.
Command list items use `<li onClick=...>` with no `role="button"` or `tabIndex`. Not keyboard-navigable; screen readers see a non-interactive list item.

Flag checkbox `<input type="checkbox">` shares `id={arg.name}` with downstream text/select/count inputs for the same argument. If two controls share the same `id`, label `htmlFor` association is ambiguous.
Execute button has no `disabled` state or `aria-busy` while the async handleExecute is in flight. User can double-submit; no loading indicator.
Detail pane uses `<h2>` for command name but the page-level heading in Catalog.tsx is also `<h2>` (line 16). Two sibling h2s on the same surface breaks document outline.
`h-[calc(100vh-290px)] min-h-[560px]` — hardcoded bracket value `290px` is brittle; depends on header+glass heights not tracked semantically. Will overflow or clip if surrounding layout changes.

stdout `<pre>` uses `whitespace-pre-wrap` but has no `max-h` + `overflow-y-auto`. Very long output will push the pane unboundedly and force the outer `overflow-y-auto` to scroll the whole right panel instead of just the output block.
`bg-black/30` hardcoded — should use a `bg-overlay-*` token or design-system surface token.

Title reads 'Command Center' but surface nav label is 'Commands' and the inner panel header reads 'Command Catalog' (line 80 of CommandCatalogForm.tsx). Three different names for the same surface — confusing hierarchy and labeling.
